messages.subject: Sandvik | Mining growth, sustainability and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Roodzant,

Sandvik sits at an important intersection for the mining industry: productivity, automation, electrification and sustainability increasingly need to advance together. Your combined responsibility for Group Communications and Sustainability makes that integration especially relevant.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory within a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I believe that operator-side perspective can add value to Sandvik's mining growth agenda by bringing a direct understanding of how technology, sustainability commitments, regulators, communities and customer operations interact at site level.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support Sandvik's communications, sustainability, stakeholder or mining-market leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
